newsitem.title: INDIA: India ONGC 96/97 crude output 28.7 mln T.
newsitem.headline: India ONGC 96/97 crude output 28.7 mln T.

text.p: India's state-run Oil and Natural Gas Corp (ONGC) said on Thursday it produced 28.7 million tonnes of crude oil in 1996/97 (April-March).
The company said in a statement the 1996/97 output was "marginally lower" than the targeted output. It did not give output figures for 1995/96.
"During the year 1996/97, ONGC had initiated various short term and long term measures to overcome the decline in production in western offshore and northeast areas of its operation," it said.
"In spite of such difficulties, ONGC produced 28.7 million tonnes of crude oil during the year which is marginally lower than the target."
The company produced 1.12 million tonnes of liquified petroleum gas (LPG) in 1996/97 exceeding the target of 993,000 tonnes, the statement said.
